moments.evidence: Un dau és damunt d’un mocador amb un extrem que sobresurt de la taula baixa.
Estira el mocador lentament. El dau avança sobre la tela fins que passa el cantell.
El dau reposa a l’estora de sota i el mocador sencer penja de la mà.

continuity.anchor: Un dau d’escuma gros i un mocador amb serrell curt.

attempts.prompt: Create ONE wide educational raster stimulus with three equal side-by-side panels, large white gutters and margins, white studio background, exactly the same single actor and all the same props with identical scale, perspective, viewing angle and lighting throughout. Flat 2D children’s educational drawing using clear shapes, solid colors and dark clean outlines, of one recognizable anthropomorphic cow; same ears, tail and functional paws throughout. Draw or photograph the following Catalan causal brief without writing any words. LEFT baseline: Un dau és damunt d’un mocador amb un extrem que sobresurt de la taula baixa. CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: Estira el mocador lentament. El dau avança sobre la tela fins que passa el cantell. RIGHT result: El dau reposa a l’estora de sota i el mocador sencer penja de la mà. Continuity and accounting: Un dau d’escuma gros i un mocador amb serrell curt. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image.
attempts.review: El mocador s’estira cap a l’esquerra, però el dau bascula cap a la dreta i no segueix el desplaçament de la tela. El cantell de caiguda necessita una trajectòria coherent.

attempts.prompt: Create ONE wide educational raster stimulus with three equal side-by-side panels, large white gutters and margins, white studio background, exactly the same single actor and all the same props with identical scale, perspective, viewing angle and lighting throughout. Flat 2D children’s educational drawing using clear shapes, solid colors and dark clean outlines, of one recognizable anthropomorphic cow; same ears, tail and functional paws throughout. Draw or photograph the following Catalan causal brief without writing any words. LEFT baseline: Un dau és damunt d’un mocador amb un extrem que sobresurt de la taula baixa. CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: Estira el mocador lentament. El dau avança sobre la tela fins que passa el cantell. RIGHT result: El dau reposa a l’estora de sota i el mocador sencer penja de la mà. Continuity and accounting: Un dau d’escuma gros i un mocador amb serrell curt. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image. Specific production fix: Use fixed side view, table on LEFT, cow kneeling on RIGHT. The square fringed neckerchief lies flat across RIGHT edge. Front is a nearly orthographic view. Cow pulls right. The die’s floor contact on fabric moves right in second panel, with half the die beyond RIGHT table edge, and then it is on the rug directly below the RIGHT edge. No other hand contacts the die.
attempts.review: El dau es mou cap al cantell dret amb el mocador quan la vaca l’estira. Es veu el dau sobrepassar la vora i acabar a l’estora, amb el mocador sencer a la pota.
